name: @nexuscontent/wordpress-companion
description: Build and local-development tooling for the NexusContent Companion WordPress plugin.

scripts.env:acf-free: wp-env run cli wp plugin install advanced-custom-fields --activate
scripts.env:acf-free:test: wp-env run tests-cli wp plugin install advanced-custom-fields --activate
scripts.env:permalinks: wp-env run cli /bin/sh -c 'wp rewrite structure "/%postname%/" && wp rewrite flush --hard'
scripts.env:no-acf: wp-env run cli wp plugin deactivate advanced-custom-fields --quiet; wp-env run cli wp plugin delete advanced-custom-fields --quiet
scripts.test:integration: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/nexuscontent bash scripts/run-test-suite.sh integration
scripts.test:integration:acf-free: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/nexuscontent env NEXUSCONTENT_TEST_ACF=1 vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.integration.xml.dist --testsuite integration --exclude-group acf-doubles
